passages.context: Sections 3-14 directly receive Luke 18:9-14 through themes of pride, penitence, contrition, and grace. The page's historically numbered Eleventh Sunday has different accompanying Introit and Epistle from the 1962 Tenth-Sunday formulary, so the passage supports reception of the Gospel only and cannot establish the architecture or historical interpretation of the entire 1962 Mass.
